title: Analyst - Data & Analytics
description: JOB DESCRIPTION This role is part of the Consumer and Community Banking Controllers team. The position will have an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment and partner with business finance team, P&A, Risk, and other groups throughout the Firm. As a result, excellent communication and negotiation skills are essential. The position demands an in-depth understanding of Retail Banking business and functions including Closing & reporting, financial statement analysis, Data Analytics, internal controls and various regulatory reporting requirements Primary Responsibilities: Month-End analytical review of the number to ensure completeness and accuracy of the financial statements and preparation of various reports Develop process flows, implement internal controls policies and procedures to mitigate financial and business risks. Constructively escalate issues and present complex information in a clear and concise manner to Management Drive & Implement strategic priorities, projects & initiatives Work on automating new and existing processes using data transformation tools like Alteryx etc Build, maintain and enhance Alteryx data transformation workflows. title: Advanced Analytics Analyst
description: Organization: At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people's financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward and make the right financial decisions to achieve their dreams, targets and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas and energy contribute to the impact we make through our work. Together, we can achieve great things. Job Title: Advanced Analytics Analyst Location: Bangalore, India Business & Team: CDAO has a vision of building a brighter future for all through data, analytics and AI. We deliver on this vision by partnering with our business colleagues to solve problems through customer-centric thinking and technical innovation, cultivating a world-class team of empowered people and building technology solutions for the future. We put the customer at the centre of everything we do and measure our performance against the Group's external customer satisfaction measures. Our team includes data and analytics engineers, data scientists and experienced leaders, bringing together a strong blend of skills. We partner closely with ASB (Auckland Savings Bank, New Zealand) to support key business objectives. Impact & Contribution: As an Advanced Analytics Analyst supporting ASB, you will be part of the Data & Analytics Domain and work closely with business teams to transform data into meaningful business impact. You will deliver actionable insights, build compelling dashboards and enable data-driven decision-making while supporting reliable data pipelines and strong stakeholder engagement. You will report to a Chapter Lead within CDAO India. Roles & Responsibilities: Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with stakeholders to understand business problems, challenge assumptions and translate ambiguous questions into clear analytical requirements. Insight Generation: Explore, analyse and interpret complex datasets to deliver meaningful insights and recommendations, rather than reports alone. Dashboards & Analytical Products: Develop and maintain high-quality dashboards, analytical products and self-service reporting with clear definitions and appropriate controls. Data Transformation & Prototyping: Prototype data transformations and analytical logic in Snowflake and Analyst Workbench, with an emphasis on reusable SQL and well-structured analytical code. Ad-hoc Analysis: Support product reviews, model validation and ILM metrics by translating business questions into data queries and providing clear, actionable insights. SQL Scheduling & Stored Procedures: Manage and maintain scheduled SQL jobs and stored procedures to support reliable data pipelines. Monitor alerts, investigate root causes and resolve failures in a sustainable manner. Stakeholder Reporting Support: Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements and deliver accurate, timely outputs that support decision-making Essential Skills: Stakeholder Communication: Strong ability to engage stakeholders, ask relevant questions and communicate insights in clear, business-friendly language. SQL & Data Engineering: Proficiency in complex SQL, data troubleshooting and data pipelines. Experience with Snowflake or another cloud-based data platform is advantageous; strong SQL capability and modern analytical practices are essential. dbt: Experience with dbt is beneficial, particularly for contributing to production-grade transformation logic or progressing towards analytics engineering. Data Visualisation: Experience building and maintaining dashboards using Tableau and Power BI, structuring reporting data and designing effective visualisations that communicate insights clearly. Attention to Detail & Ownership: A high level of accuracy, consistency and reliability across data, reports and processes, with strong ownership of deliverables. Insight Generation: Ability to convert analytical findings into meaningful, actionable business insights that support decision-making. Git & Version Control: Comfortable, or willing to become comfortable, managing analytical code using source control, branches, pull requests and peer review. Statistical & Machine Learning Knowledge: Working knowledge of statistical methods and machine learning techniques relevant to analytical use cases. AI & Regulatory Awareness: Ability to identify opportunities to apply AI and analytics while meeting regulatory, risk and governance requirements. Ways of Working: Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality analysis, build strong peer relationships, manage processes efficiently and communicate effectively with a range of audiences. Education Qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, with 4+ years of relevant experience. If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career. We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696. Advertising End Date: 03/12/2026

description: About Yulu Yulu is India’s largest shared electric mobility-as-a-service company. Role Summary We are looking for a data-driven Analyst to strengthen inventory visibility, material control, and process improvement across ReCircle operations. The role will maintain reliable inventory data across locations and systems, analyse material flows, and translate insights into practical improvements in how materials are received, stored, tracked, allocated, refurbished, reused, and disposed of. The candidate will use advanced Excel, SQL, dashboards, automation, and AI-enabled tools to identify inefficiencies, improve data quality, reduce material losses and ageing, and support evidence-based operational decisions. This role combines inventory analytics with hands-on improvement of material and inventory management processes. Key Responsibilities 1. Inventory Data & Control Maintain accurate, complete, and timely inventory records across warehouses, cities, locations, and relevant systems. Define and maintain clear data structures for SKUs, part codes, descriptions, units of measure, condition/status, location, ownership, and material disposition. Monitor inventory movements and ensure transactions are recorded correctly for receipts, transfers, issues, returns, refurbishment, reuse, recycling, and scrap. Conduct regular system-to-physical reconciliations; investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and coordinate corrective actions with warehouse and operations teams. • Track inventory by quantity, value where available, age, condition, movement history, and disposition category. Support cycle counts and inventory audits; improve traceability and adherence to inventory control processes. 2. Material Flow & ReCircle Process Improvement Map and analyse material flows across the ReCircle lifecycle, including collection, segregation, storage, refurbishment, reuse, warranty claims, recycling, and scrap disposal. • Identify bottlenecks, avoidable material movements, excess or dormant stock, repeat handling, process gaps, and opportunities to improve turnaround time and material recovery. • Help establish standard operating procedures, transaction controls, material status definitions, and clear ownership at each stage of the inventory lifecycle. Develop recommendations to improve material availability, storage discipline, inventory ageing, space utilisation, stock rotation, and disposition decisions. Work with warehouse, refurbishment, procurement, city operations, finance, and other stakeholders to implement improvements and track their impact. Support material planning and allocation by providing visibility into available, blocked, repairable, reusable, recyclable, and obsolete inventory. 3. Data Analysis, SQL & Reporting Use SQL to query, join, validate, and analyse large datasets from available operational systems and data sources. Build and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly reports and dashboards covering inventory position, movement, ageing, discrepancies, material recovery, and process performance. • Analyse trends and exceptions to identify root causes, emerging risks, and actionable opportunities rather than only reporting historical numbers. Develop and maintain Excel-based tools using advanced formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, charts, and automation where appropriate. Define consistent KPI calculations, reporting logic, data validation checks, and documentation so that reports are reliable and repeatable. Present findings clearly to operational stakeholders and recommend specific actions, owners, and follow-up measures. 4. AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement Use approved AI tools to accelerate data exploration, generate and validate SQL or spreadsheet logic, summarise trends, identify anomalies, and support root-cause analysis. • Identify repeatable manual reporting and reconciliation tasks that can be simplified or automated using SQL, Excel, scripts, workflow tools, or AI-assisted methods. Pilot practical analytics use cases such as anomaly detection, ageing-risk flags, duplicate or inconsistent records, demand and replenishment signals, and material disposition recommendations. Validate AI-generated outputs against source data and business rules; protect confidential data and follow company policies for approved tools and data access. Measure the impact of improvements through defined baselines, adoption, time saved, data quality gains, or operational outcomes. 5. Stakeholder Support & Capability Building Coordinate with Procurement, Warehouse, Refurbishment, City Operations, Finance, and other relevant teams to resolve inventory and material-flow issues. Train and support team members on inventory data discipline, reporting practices, Excel tools, dashboards, and standard processes. Document key reports, data definitions, SOPs, reconciliation methods, and recurring issue resolution steps to reduce dependency on individual team members. Follow up on agreed actions and communicate material risks, data gaps, and process deviations in a timely manner. Required Skills & Competencies Sound understanding of inventory management, stock control, material movements, reconciliation, ageing, and warehouse processes. Strong proficiency in SQL, including joins, aggregations, filtering, data validation, and querying multi-table datasets. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, Power Query, lookup and aggregation formulas, charts, and dashboard creation. Practical ability to use AI tools for data analysis, productivity, automation, and problem-solving, with the judgment to verify outputs. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate variances and identify root causes. Close attention to detail, data integrity, and disciplined documentation. Ability to convert analysis into clear operational recommendations and measurable process improvements. Good communication, stakeholder coordination, and training skills. Comfort working with large datasets and with operational teams in a fast-moving environment. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Commerce, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field. 0–2 years of relevant experience in inventory management, supply chain analytics, operations, or data analysis; practical projects demonstrating SQL and Excel skills may also be considered. Experience with ERP, WMS, inventory management systems, or operational data platforms is preferred. Exposure to AI-assisted analytics, reporting automation, Power BI, or similar dashboarding tools is an advantage. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Inventory record accuracy and reduction in physical-versus-system stock variance. • Completeness and quality of inventory master data and transaction records. • Reduction in aged, dormant, unidentified, or unclassified inventory. Material traceability and timely recording of receipts, transfers, issues, and disposition. • Improvement in material recovery visibility and the proportion of materials correctly classified for reuse, refurbishment, recycling, warranty, or scrap.
